## Satis Appraisal v0.2.3

### Pricing estimates fixed and visible
- **"Sales & rents" estimation works again.** v0.2.2's extraction schema was rejected by the API on real projects ("the compiled grammar is too large"); the wire format is now compact and the run completes.
- **A real progress bar during estimation.** The bar advances with each web search the research actually performs, and every group shows its live stage — asking Claude, web search 4, reading the evidence, extracting the figures — so a minute of research no longer looks like a hang. Failures now appear on the failed row in plain language: an account with no API credit is told to top up under Plans & Billing rather than shown a raw error.

Everything shipped in v0.2.2 — pricing estimates with ranges and sources, exact SDLT from HMRC bands, calibration records, the Claude sign-in that installs nothing by hand — is unchanged and described in the [v0.2.2 notes](https://github.com/Satisgroup-1/Appraisalapplication/releases/tag/v0.2.2).

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/Satisgroup-1/Appraisalapplication/compare/v0.2.2...v0.2.3
